prerequisites: No prerequisites. Competences taught in the modules Machine Learning and either Foundations of Statistics or Elementary Stochastics are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: The students can explain the basics of deep neural networks and Deep Learning.
The students can describe common optimization and regularization techniques in Deep Learning.
The students can explain common architectures of deep neural networks.
The students can apply Deep Learning frameworks to implement solutions in an application area.
The students can identify new developments in the field of Deep Learning.
The students are able to apply scientific working methods in independently recognizing, formulating, and solving problems.

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercise assignments (at least 50% of points achieved)
Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments
Oral examination (individual examination) or written exam

assessment_rules: Grading is based on a scale of 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Data Science degree program. To receive credits, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution for at least two of these assignments. The final examination is an oral exam or a written exam.
